meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会使用 ETE 4 读取和改写 Newick 等树文件,进行修剪、定根、拓扑比较,识别基因树中的复制与分化事件,调用 NCBI 分类注释节点,并输出 PDF/SVG 图像。
howto.when: 当用户要求读取/改写树文件、比较树拓扑差异或识别基因树演化事件时触发;也用于 NCBI 分类注释与树图渲染。不用于从原始序列推断谱系树。

say.text: 帮我读取 tree.nw,打印叶子数和节点数。
say.note: 会用 ETE 打开并输出统计。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use ETE 4 to read/write Newick, NHX, PhyloXML, and NeXML tree files; prune, root, and edit topology; compute Robinson-Foulds distances; detect duplication and speciation events in gene trees; integrate NCBI taxonomy; and render PDF/SVG figures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to parse/edit tree files, compare tree topologies, identify gene-tree evolutionary events, use NCBI taxonomy annotation, or render tree figures; not for inferring trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Read tree.nw and print the number of leaves and nodes.
say_en.note: Claude loads it with ETE and outputs stats.

say_en.text: Midpoint-root gene_tree.nw, prune to species in keep.txt, and save.
say_en.note: ETE processes and writes the modified file.

say_en.text: Compare tree1.nw and tree2.nw with Robinson-Foulds and explain the result.
say_en.note: Returns RF distance and shared/unique partitions.
